purpose: Turn the remaining B1 18-20 backlog into explicit unblock contracts. A row marked blocked must not be approximated with heat, role, month, a metadata-only seedsRead entry, or a synthetic REAL_* flag.

closedByAgent11.repair: Restore Clara-contact OR sufficient PUBLIC_HEAT reachability.
Require absence of acute injury in the already-correct first-full-summer window.

remainingPrincipals.canonicalNeed: Official debut plus compatible live match score/context and player role.
remainingPrincipals.missingAuthority: A persisted/live match-context fact proving the score/game-state and protagonist role at the decision moment.
remainingPrincipals.minimalUnblock: Expose an authoritative match-context predicate or event fact generated by the match simulation; then add only the missing gate and retain existing choices, effects and SEED_MENA_EARLY_READ.

remainingPrincipals.canonicalNeed: After first official debut OR first match call-up, with local attention.
remainingPrincipals.missingAuthority: A match-squad first-call-up fact distinct from the always-on initial preseason call.
remainingPrincipals.minimalUnblock: Expose a first match-squad call-up fact and gate the scene on local attention AND (OFFICIAL_DEBUT OR FIRST_MATCH_SQUAD_CALL).

remainingPrincipals.canonicalNeed: Minimum PUBLIC_HEAT plus no match within 24 hours and a later training context.
remainingPrincipals.missingAuthority: Next-match/training calendar facts capable of proving the 24-hour exclusion and subsequent training.
remainingPrincipals.minimalUnblock: Expose deterministic schedule facts and add the missing calendar conditions without altering SEED_DANI_NORMALITY.

remainingPrincipals.canonicalNeed: January 1-20; options depend on role, contract, market heat and real alternatives. LOAN/TRANSFER must exist before they are shown.
currentAuthority: market.pending for formal offers in the professional market system
remainingPrincipals.missingAuthority: Age-18 real loan/buyer alternatives materialized before this scene and queryable without creating them from the choice itself.
remainingPrincipals.minimalUnblock: Materialize age-18 market alternatives as authoritative offer/proposal state, then gate LOAN and TRANSFER with choice eligibility and prove that unavailable exits never mutate club/route.

remainingPrincipals.canonicalNeed: Last four league matches while the club objective is still unresolved.
remainingPrincipals.missingAuthority: Exact final-four-match window plus explicit objective-open state before resolution.
remainingPrincipals.minimalUnblock: Expose remaining-league-matches/objective-open facts from competition simulation and gate the scene on both.

remainingPrincipals.canonicalNeed: End of season plus Montalbán genuinely questioned plus sufficient PUBLIC_HEAT.
remainingPrincipals.missingAuthority: A canonical coach-questioned/continuity-undecided fact or an explicitly approved coachSecurity threshold.
remainingPrincipals.minimalUnblock: Define the questioned-but-not-fired state authoritatively; then add that gate while preserving the existing press decision.

remainingPrincipals.canonicalNeed: June after first season; REQUEST_EXIT only when an actual offer exists.
remainingPrincipals.missingAuthority: A demonstrated age-18 formal offer materialization path available before summer decision resolution.
remainingPrincipals.minimalUnblock: Materialize/query a real age-18 offer first, then make REQUEST_EXIT eligible only when that offer exists and route acceptance through offer authority instead of direct synthetic club mutation.

remainingConditionals.canonicalNeed: Early breakout/public-heat causal condition without extra unapproved restrictions.
remainingConditionals.currentGap: EARLY_BREAKOUT writer additionally requires form >= 60 and RNG materialization; callback also narrows by mediaHeat.
remainingConditionals.minimalUnblock: Define a deterministic canonical breakout fact/provenance covering the approved sporting/public routes, then gate the conditional from that fact. Do not alter football RNG sequencing casually.

remainingConditionals.canonicalNeed: SEED_BRUNO_FAVOR must causally modify farewell/future recommendation.
remainingConditionals.currentGap: Seed is metadata-only in this callback.
remainingConditionals.minimalUnblock: Add an explicit seed-derived modifier/branch/effect with canonical semantics and test both with/without favor memory.

remainingConditionals.canonicalNeed: Prior public coach stance must change reception after Montalbán leaves.
remainingConditionals.currentGap: SEED_COACH_PUBLIC/SEED_MENA_EARLY_READ are read as metadata but do not alter reception.
remainingConditionals.minimalUnblock: Implement a real memory-dependent modifier/branch and prove NPC knowledge remains causal.

remainingConditionals.canonicalNeed: Stay/exit route strength changes with contract/route state and prior exit-style memory.
remainingConditionals.currentGap: Choices are static; SEED_EXIT_STYLE_UDV is metadata-only.
remainingConditionals.minimalUnblock: Use authoritative contract/route state plus active seed memory to modify eligibility/outcome weights/effects; test contrasting contract states.

remainingConditionals.canonicalNeed: Unexpected success must explicitly increase retention-versus-market pressure.
remainingConditionals.currentGap: Generic role/market deltas do not prove that causal retention effect.
remainingConditionals.minimalUnblock: Represent retention pressure as an explicit consequence/fact consumed by the summer route; prove it survives save/restore.

remainingConditionals.canonicalNeed: Conflicting information with an independent hidden truth about source quality.
remainingConditionals.currentGap: Which source was better informed is manufactured by choice/outcome rather than independent world truth.
remainingConditionals.minimalUnblock: Materialize hidden source-quality truth before the choice and consume it without leaking it to player/NPCs that cannot know it.

remainingConditionals.canonicalNeed: Complication probability/function must depend on body/treatment history as well as load/chance.
remainingConditionals.currentGap: LONG_INJURY is produced from risk/RNG; body-treatment seeds are metadata-only for this complication.
remainingConditionals.minimalUnblock: Add an explicit causal modifier from SEED_BODY_PRECEDENT/SEED_PHYSIO_CONFIDENCE to injury evolution, then retest determinism and save/restore.

remainingConditionals.canonicalNeed: NIGHT_PHOTO OR (high exposure AND recent conflict).
remainingConditionals.currentGap: Runtime uses NIGHT_PHOTO AND mediaHeat>=15 and has no exact recent-conflict fact.
remainingConditionals.minimalUnblock: Define/prove a causal recent-conflict predicate, then use gateAlternatives for the two canonical routes. NIGHT_PHOTO alone must remain a valid route.

remainingConditionals.canonicalNeed: Loan return recalculates hierarchy and relationships, informed by prior exit style.
remainingConditionals.currentGap: Club/loan/role/control change, but relationships are not recalculated and SEED_EXIT_STYLE_UDV is metadata-only.
remainingConditionals.minimalUnblock: Apply explicit relationship/hierarchy consequences from authoritative pre-return state and exit-style memory; test no omniscient NPC propagation.

priorityUnblockContracts.reason: One shared market fact can close two high-impact principal scenes and remove direct synthetic transfer mutations.
Match call-up, live match context and remaining/objective state are currently the largest principal reachability gap.
Small shared fact, low implementation surface once semantics are defined.
Five callbacks currently list memory without consuming it causally.

rules: Do not invent a fact merely to satisfy choice eligibility.
Do not use a heat/role scalar as evidence of a discrete world event unless the canonical contract explicitly defines that mapping.
A seed in seedsRead is not a causal consumer by itself.
Any EVENTS-changing repair requires a new adjacent contentIdentity generation and migration evidence.
Exact-ID reachability-only repairs should normally preserve same-scene scheduler semantics when player-facing decision/journal semantics are unchanged.
